{"kind":"effect-plugin","definition":{"id":"effect.affix.yinqu-channel-clarity","name":"澄渠","kind":"affix","scope":"equipment","version":1,"description":"银渠实际击伤并沿水锋成功破膜后，主人获得1.2秒澄明，缩短窗口内新受敌方灼痕、雷痕的持续时间，比例见词值。不清除旧印，不缩短水膜。同类取强，同强刷新，弱者不续时。","iconGuid":"493e2b8f-fa11-5fdb-8898-f4701c5a58e9","families":["survival.owner-contact-clarity"],"mechanism":{"kind":"affix","parameters":{"stat":"contactStatusStrength","operation":"increased","scopeByKind":{"weapon":"equipment"},"sourceDomain":{"effectiveUsage":"player","modules":["returning-sword"],"boards":[],"ownerChain":["atlas-s14"],"purePresentation":false,"ordinaryAvailability":"module-gated","moduleEvidence":"银渠私有澄渠；本件正式接触核验准确条件与受体，非单凭元素或状态图标。"},"eligibility":{"id":"affix.roll.yinqu-channel-clarity","name":"澄渠","systems":["returning-sword"],"introducedInPoolVersion":3,"definitionVersion":1,"balanceVersion":1,"comparableRuleVersion":1,"ownerEquipmentId":"atlas-s14","slot":"suffix","unit":"percent","stat":"contactStatusStrength","operation":"increased","visualSignal":"rune","consumer":{"capability":"sword-tuning","version":11},"recordPolicy":"higher","allowedKinds":["weapon"],"poolKinds":["weapon"],"poolFamilies":["returning-melee"],"scopeByKind":{"weapon":"equipment"},"minRarity":4,"minimumItemLevel":1,"selectionWeight":0.4,"budgetCost":10,"maximumEffectiveValue":0.4,"conflicts":[],"contactStatus":{"statusId":"sword-contact-clarity","trigger":"consumed-status","consumedStatusId":"elemental-frost-bind","recipient":"owner"}}}},"strength":[{"field":"value","label":"主人新受印记持续时间降低比例","formula":{"kind":"affix-range","definitionId":"affix.roll.yinqu-channel-clarity","baseValue":0.14,"valuePerTier":0.014,"operation":"increased","unit":"比例（0.05表示5%）","levels":{"min":1,"max":100,"kind":"integer"}}}],"relations":{"defaultWeight":0,"familyRules":[],"targetOverrides":[{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s14.continuous-returning-strike","weight":0.6,"reason":"本词只属于银渠；真实接触事实与词值来自本件实物，关系本身不执行状态。"},{"targetId":"effect.status.sword-contact-clarity","weight":1,"reason":"本词实际强度调用此状态；只声明正式结果，不追加一次伤害、施印、付款或状态层。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s14.water-guided-edge","weight":1.1,"reason":"本器沿水锋须真正消费精确水膜；仅带膜或零扣血不满足。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s13.condense-water-film","weight":1.1,"reason":"寒铸确实留下外膜，可供银渠后手破膜；距离、消耗竞争和时序仍可能让条件落空。"},{"targetId":"effect.cangshui-returning-sword.condense-water-film","weight":1,"reason":"截流确实留下外膜，可供银渠后手破膜；距离、消耗竞争和时序仍可能让条件落空。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s06.condense-water-film","weight":0.9,"reason":"回澜确实留下外膜，可供银渠后手破膜；距离、消耗竞争和时序仍可能让条件落空。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s25.condense-water-film","weight":0.9,"reason":"镜流熨锋确实留下外膜，可供银渠后手破膜；距离、消耗竞争和时序仍可能让条件落空。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s17.condense-water-film","weight":0.8,"reason":"沉潮确实留下外膜，镇压不算第二份供膜，可供银渠后手破膜；距离、消耗竞争和时序仍可能让条件落空。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s18.condense-water-film","weight":0.8,"reason":"润岳确实留下外膜，自修不算第二份供膜，可供银渠后手破膜；距离、消耗竞争和时序仍可能让条件落空。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s14.seek-marked-first","weight":0.25,"reason":"寻膜有助找到前置，但不保证飞行抵达前膜仍存续。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s22.steam-film-rupture","weight":0,"reason":"沸锋消费外膜，是竞争者而不是外膜供应者。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s24.condense-water-film","weight":0,"reason":"汽焰锁同击凝即耗，不留下可供银渠后手的外膜。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.yinqu-residual-drag","weight":0.15,"reason":"同次真实破膜可分别给主人短状态与敌人拖滞；彼此非前置，不提高状态幅度。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.water-delayed-action","weight":0.1,"reason":"凝拍按正伤害慢敌行动，破膜非它前置；与本词只作低权战术分工。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.yinqu-membrane-guard","weight":0.15,"reason":"共享护持与本词端点不同；可读取同次破膜，但不叠触发概率或状态层。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.yinqu-borrowed-step","weight":0.15,"reason":"同一次破膜可分别带来主人轻步和澄明；结果不同，不能补造前置。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.cuihong-quench-clarity","weight":0,"reason":"同类结果共用一个最强状态，只能竞争或接替，不能因不同词名叠层。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.cangye-kill-clarity","weight":0,"reason":"同类结果共用一个最强状态，不制造层数或概率加成。"},{"targetId":"effect.status.sword-contact-ward","weight":0,"reason":"其他主人短状态不能补造本词的准确接触条件。"},{"targetId":"effect.status.sword-contact-haste","weight":0,"reason":"其他主人短状态不能补造本词的准确接触条件。"}]},"designNotes":["必须本件银渠实际扣血并由沿水锋真正消费准确水膜。无膜、被他剑先耗、移除失败、零伤、纯盾、状态tick均失败；目标死亡后仍可给活主人结果。无需先装破膜护。","m(L)=0.14+0.014×(L−1)/10，L为1至100整数；自然掷值round5([0.8m,1.2m])，每级名义值增加0.0014；最大有效值0.4，自然L100上沿低于该上限。","R4、L1起，后缀预算10、基础选择权重0.4；所属主击准入权重0.4，不是最终掉率。introducedInPoolVersion为3，旧历史选择视图不得据新关系重掷旧物件。","澄明以receivedMarkDurationReduction的at-least端点与已有防护取max(A,x)，最终不超过40%；只影响新受或刷新且声明接受防护的敌方印记，目前为灼痕和雷痕，不清旧印、不改水膜。","固定1.2秒，同名只取最强、同强刷新、弱者不换源也不续时；卸装、停发或禁用停止新触发，既有短状态按原规则自然到期。","每剑最多3个后缀，接触只读预先准备的条件与真实回执；不追加收费、耗印、伤害包、世界实体或战场特效圈。","不增加单目标木桩无条件DPS，也不提前计入默认生存承伤主数字；条件结果和受体在详情解释。","词到结果是调用关系，结果到词只用0权来源追溯；必带工序不重复主击准入，真实外部供给按逐向边提高机会，非所有同元素一律关联。","左右水膜裂开形成清渠，中心留一枚通透菱形；不用盾或脚印，表示破膜后的澄明而非减伤。"],"placement":{"contentPackId":"base-returning-sword","categoryPath":["weapons","atlas-s14","effects","attributes"],"scope":"exclusive","owner":{"kind":"weapon","id":"atlas-s14","name":"银渠"}},"provenance":{"sourcePaths":["assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s14/effects/attributes/affix.yinqu-channel-clarity/effect.pack.ts","assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s14/effects/attributes/affix.yinqu-channel-clarity/item-affix.pack.ts","src/combat/sword-contact-status.ts","src/combat/status-system.ts","src/combat/combat-runtime.ts","docs/design/proposals/SIX-SWORD-SUFFIX-CLOSEOUT.md"],"legacyNodeIds":["affix.roll.yinqu-channel-clarity"]}}}
